Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study contains multiple MS experiments: 1) AP-MS for Polθ binding partners, 2) Phosphorylation site mapping/quantification of Polθ, and 3) Peptide pull-down MS for phosphorylated Polθ peptides. All use LFQ and DDA (implied by Orbitrap Exploris/Eclipse and Sequest HT search). The primary focus is on phosphorylation (mod_phospho) and protein-protein interactions (mod_ap_ms).

scope: For Polθ peptide 4S-P (1482-P/1486-P/1488-P/1493-P) binding partners identification by mass spectrometry (MS), nuclear extracts from HeLa cells (666 ¼mg) were incubated with 1 nmol of 4S-P streptavidin beads-coupled peptide
Peptides were coupled to streptavidin beads in 150 mM NaCl on a wheel at room temperature, during 1 hour. Beads were washed twice in 150 mM NaCl prior to use in pull-down assays.
subcellular_fraction: nuclear extracts from HeLa cells (666 ¼mg) were incubated with 1 nmol of 4S-P streptavidin beads-coupled peptide

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material was an affinity-purified complex (pull-down) using biotinylated Polθ peptides coupled to streptavidin beads, derived from HeLa nuclear extracts.
